summary: Frontend-only retest for CloudIVR Emily (chat setup). All 7 requested scenarios PASS on first attempt, including the iteration_308 S2 regression (menu-mode stop-9 promise bug) which is now fixed: Emily's menu-mode campaign script no longer contains 'Press 9 to stop these calls.' and the campaign-flow card shows no errors. Also verified: Emily does NOT invent facts (phone numbers, opening hours, PINs, payment URLs) — on an incomplete request she replies with an 'Almost there — I just need ...' bullet list and NO proposal card, and only writes a Fill-in-the-form proposal after the owner answers. Campaign transfer/survey modes correctly default stopKey=9 with matching stop-calls line. Edit-one-key keeps every other key intact. Quick-call proposal fills targets/transferTo/stopKey=None/activeKeys=[1] with no flow errors. Alice's +13346970100 keypad menu was reloaded between runs and never saved; final DOM state matches the initial state verbatim.
critical_code_review_comments: assist.js:397-404 — 'no stop key in effect → script must not promise one' post-hoc stripper (BP.stripStopPromise) is now kicking in correctly for menu/otp modes; S1A and S1B both produced menu-mode scripts with NO stop-9 clause and campaign-flow had zero errors. Good belt-and-braces alongside the prompt rule.

assist.js:304-378 — invented() guard + askFor() bullet-list ('Almost there — I just need …') works on IVR for both the Harbor Club request and the bakery request: first reply has NO apply button and lists the exact missing items. After the owner answers, a proposal card appears with ONLY the values the owner supplied.
ivr-blueprint.js:211 (stopKey whitelist) — correctly suppresses the stopKey field when mode='menu' (sk_count=0 on S1A/S1B) so the stop-promise/stopKey mismatch validation never fires in menu mode.

Edit path: asking 'Change key 1 so it rings +14155550162 instead' correctly returns a bullet-list 'Almost there…' that only asks for the phone. After applying, key 2 (sms action, smsText and Texting Number) is preserved verbatim. Non-destructive patch confirmed.
seed_data_creation: None. Alice's +13346970100 keypad menu was NOT saved; after every scenario the page was reloaded, Leave-without-saving was accepted, and the greeting ('Press 1 for orders, press 2 for our menu by text.'), option-0 (digit=1 forward to +14155550100, label Orders), option-1 (digit=2 sms with smsText 'Menu: bella.com/menu', label Menu) and ivr-enabled-toggle=off are all preserved as found. No campaigns saved; no Quick calls placed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 4 requested fixes are live and passing: (1) menu-mode scripts no longer promise key 9; (2) Emily no longer invents phones/addresses/hours/PINs/prices — she returns an 'Almost there — I just need …' bullet list with NO proposal card until the owner supplies the data; (3) campaign transfer & record_only modes default stopKey=9 with matching script line; (4) builder edits preserve untouched keys. Not re-tested in this iteration: the manual IVR builder regression (webhook/collect/PIN/pay/queue/3-level sub-menu checks + 'Test my menu' report). These were covered by earlier iterations and the Assist-driven applies in S4/S5/S6 already exercised PIN+forward, pay URL, forward, sms and message actions end-to-end without flow errors. If a full manual-builder sweep is requested, start from the Keypad menu tab of +13346970100.
